verdict.rationale: LiveKit documents its own voice-agent framework, which joins live rooms and handles turn detection and interruptions, plus LiveKit Inference for running AI models inside LiveKit Cloud. Together these imply that live session audio is fed to AI models while the session runs. However, the pack never explicitly describes streaming room audio to a transcription (STT) or realtime model endpoint. Egress only covers files and RTMP, not model endpoints. missing for 10: explicit docs on routing live audio to STT or realtime model endpoints, a list of supported transcription or realtime providers, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, live session audio can be streamed to a transcription or realtime model endpoint while the session is running

citations.quote: Build a simple voice agent with Python or Node.js in less than 10 minutes.
Automatic turn detection and interruption handling
LiveKit Inference lets you run supported AI models directly within the LiveKit Cloud environment without requiring API keys.
